name: Justin Abrams
bio: Spent 15 years scaling local businesses across New England before starting the Boston Marketing Company. Believes great marketing should be measurable, honest, and built around real customer relationships — not vanity metrics.

name: Josh Eissler
bio: Built the data, attribution, and automation stack that powers every campaign we run. Engineering background applied to marketing — believes the agencies that win the next decade will be the ones with the best tech under the hood.

name: Vivian Sierra
bio: Runs day-to-day client relationships and keeps every project on track. Worked in client services at two Boston agencies before joining — knows that great account management is half strategist, half therapist, all advocate.

name: Shohel Das
bio: Owns end-to-end growth for our key accounts — strategy, execution, optimization, expansion. Came up running paid media for B2B SaaS before going broader. Loves compounding wins, hates random-act-of-marketing decisions.
